material_improvement_rule: Ornith median recall must be at least 1/3 and strictly greater than the matched Qwen3-Coder Q4_0 baseline median.

invalid_preflight.reason: The first target invocation ran beneath the current checkout, whose root conftest placed HEAD package sources ahead of the requested target PYTHONPATH. Import-provenance enforcement exposed the mismatch; this result is excluded.

scoring_rule: A known defect counts only when a validated report finding identifies the affected behavior and relevant symbol or call path. Separately reported defects can be true findings but do not increase recall against the frozen denominator.

known_defects.behavior: redundant batch embedding and Chroma insertion after per-episode storage
dead PID text causes replacement of a pathname whose inode is actively flocked
a persisted same-count BM25 cache is accepted despite a newer collection mutation marker

coverage_correction.reason: The baseline used relative package paths, while the harness attributes only commands containing literal /workspace/package paths and omits relevant root-level callers and package contract documents. Independent scoring applies the preregistered production-source plus distinct test, caller, README, or package-contract rule to exact transcripts.

interpretation.objective_recall: Ornith did not identify any of the three independently graded defects in any seed, so the preregistered improvement threshold was not met.
interpretation.lead_following: Two seeds read an internal handoff that explicitly named two different OPEN Engram defects and then reproduced those behaviors. This is evidence of useful lead verification, not hidden-defect recall or independent discovery.
interpretation.termination: Perfect performance on the synthetic recovery suite did not transfer to autonomous stopping: all three repository runs bound the 45-turn cap and required forced reports.
interpretation.causal_limit: The Qwen comparison is sequential and Ornith used active MTP while the matched Qwen Q4_0 baseline did not. Outcome differences cannot be attributed solely to model weights.
